lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li3CoF6 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with a unit cell containing 30 atoms—Li6Co3F18—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Co and Li centers, each with six F neighbors, while F adopts a square-pyramidal environment with one Co and four Li neighbors. The Co and Li octahedra show corner- and edge-sharing, and the F square pyramids share corners and edges, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
